[[File:Wetlander Spearman.jpg|thumb|right|A Wetlander spearman.]]

'''Wetlander''' is an [[Aiel]] term used to refer to those who live west of the [[Spine of the World]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, wetlander}} Its origin derives from the fact that the [[Westlands]] are a much "wetter" place than the [[Aiel Waste|Three-fold Land]]. The term is often used as a pejorative by the Aiel who view those not hailing from the [[Aiel Waste]] as being weak and soft.
